title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 32
paragraphs: On reaching Sardis, he first sent heralds to Greece to demand earth and water and to give notice in advance that meals should be prepared for the king. However, he sent no envoys to Athens or Lacedaemon to ask for earth, but only to the other states. The reason for sending a second time to ask for earth and water was this: those who had not given them to Darius when he asked before, these, Xerxes thought, would certainly give them now out of fear. This was the matter about which he wished to have reliable information, and so he sent the envoys.
